book.name: 1 Kolinita
book.title: 1 KOLINITA MeKolinita ꞌidi leta ꞌaigeda Paulo ꞌileleya

content: Keliso ꞌana tohepwailao ꞌidi miya mwau weyahina
Sowasowana ma wasanapumai ꞌabehega tauma Keliso ꞌina topaihowao, weyahina tetelaina Yehoba ꞌoinega mwalo dahwadahwaina ma bewa tuwa ꞌahehepwaile ꞌoimiya.
Cima paihowaina ꞌoina ꞌilobwaineya ma ꞌapaihowa bwaibwaina.
Cigu paihowa bewa weyahina, ꞌeguma waꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegauwa bo nuwana waꞌahwa galagalaegau, ꞌimi nuwatuhuwedi bo hali tomotaiyao ꞌidi nuwatuhu weyahigu, geya toꞌaha ꞌoiguwa.
Ta wete taugu ꞌigu nuwatuhu ꞌabehega ꞌigu paihowaina bwebweꞌana, ma hesi geya yasanapu bwaibwaini, nuwana bwebweꞌana bo galana, Yehobamo ꞌisanasanapu.

Bewa tuwa sahena ꞌeta taiya ꞌiyanao ꞌoidiya ꞌihesihesinuwa ꞌabehega bwebweꞌadi bo galadi, weyahina ꞌabwa ꞌida Bada ꞌinaoma ma ꞌiboinamo ꞌiloinaegita. Ta ꞌina loinaina dumwaluna weyahina ꞌida nuwatuhu galadi ꞌateda Yehoba ꞌiꞌabilatuhedi ma ꞌiloinaegita, eema ꞌida nuwatuhu bwebweꞌadi ꞌiꞌabilatuhedi, ma weyahidi ꞌiꞌahwa bwebweꞌanegita.

Cebeꞌita bewa taugu ma Apolosa ꞌoimega waꞌita, ma ꞌoinega ꞌedaꞌeda bwebweꞌana sahena waꞌebeꞌebesine, ma sahena wagwaegwae hanehane ꞌimi tohanugetao weyahidi, ꞌabehega ꞌaigeda ꞌimi tohanugeta ꞌibwebweꞌana hedada.
Sahena wanuwanuwa hanehane ma ꞌabehega ꞌiyamiyao wabwebweꞌana sinediya, weyahina toꞌaha bwebweꞌana ꞌoimiya simiyamiya mabwaiyana Yehoba ꞌoinega walobeya, ꞌoinega sahena wagwaegwae hanehane.

Cana ꞌita geya bwebweꞌana weyahina wagwaegwae ꞌabehega wahewaiwai pwaiya, ma ginaula mabwaiyadi sowasowahimi, ꞌoinega walaꞌwemaiya. Moisa, nuwanuwagu ma wada hewaiwai ma tapwalolo ꞌoinega wada hewasawasa, ma ꞌoinega ꞌomi ma tauma tada hemahemahetena.

Ta hesi bewa tuwa ꞌana ꞌita gide Yehoba ꞌana tohepwailao tauma miya mwauna ꞌiꞌebwaemaiya, gidemusa taudi paipaidi sabi loheꞌamasidi, ma ꞌoinega aneloseyao ma loheloheyao ma ginaula mabwaiyana siꞌeꞌebubumai.

Ta ꞌama ꞌita gidemusa yauyauleima Keliso weyahina, ma hesi ꞌami ꞌita gidemusa taudi Keliso ꞌana tosanapuwao, weyahina tauma weꞌaweꞌaima ma ꞌomi waiwaimi, ta maꞌami heꞌasisi, ma tauma hesi maꞌima debamwadina.
Tuta baibaiwana maꞌama gomale ta maꞌama taniꞌo yahala, ta geya ꞌama ꞌaleꞌomo, ma wete geya ꞌima hadamo, ꞌoinega ꞌama ꞌita gide tomiya nanaewa.
Tauma nimamega ꞌapaipaihowa, ma ꞌeguma taiyewedi siꞌahwa galagalaemai gwae helauwega ꞌahemaisadi, ma wete ꞌeguma siꞌabi hemuyamuyaemai tuwa ꞌaꞌalamaꞌiꞌita.
Ta wete ꞌeguma sigamwasowalemaiya, maꞌima nuwa bwebweꞌana ꞌaheꞌiyaꞌiyaguwedi. Moisa, tauma gide mohomoho, ꞌoinega tomota silogwahatemaiya.
Gwae bewa yaleleyawa geya ꞌabehega yaꞌabihedeba mwadinegomi, ma hesiyage sabi hedumwalugomi gide natugwao moisa ꞌomi.
Moisa, ꞌimi toheꞌitao boda hedada Keliso ꞌina ꞌedaꞌedao weyahina, ma yaboigumo tuwa tamamiu, weyahina tetela bwebweꞌana ꞌana guguya ꞌoinega yaꞌewegomiya Yesu Keliso ꞌoina.
Coinega natugwao, yaꞌahwanoi ꞌoimiya ma waheꞌauꞌaunawegau.

Ma natugu Timoti yahewasaeyawa ma ꞌane ꞌihepwaile ꞌoimiya, ꞌigu hemisa Keliso ꞌoina weyahina, gidemusa tohekalesiyao yaheꞌitediya ꞌasa mabwaiyana ꞌoidiya, ta ꞌoinega sahena wanuwanuwa naidedi. Timotiina yahelauweya ma yahemiseya, weyahina ꞌida Bada ꞌina paihowa ꞌoina ꞌihetapewa hedada, ma bewa tuwa ꞌinaonaowa ꞌoimiya.
Ta hesi tupwadi ꞌoimiyega sinuwatuhuya ꞌabehega taugu sahena yanaonaowa. Coinega sinuwanuwahane ma sigagagagasa.

Geya! Ma hesi ꞌeguma ꞌida Bada ꞌitagwala, ꞌabwa yalomwayamwayau ma yanaowa ꞌoimiya, ma taudi togagasaedi yatohodi geya ꞌabehega ꞌidi gwaemo ꞌoidiyega ma ꞌidi paihowao wete yaꞌitadi, waiwaidi bo weꞌaweꞌadi.
Weyahina Yehoba ꞌina ꞌebeloina ꞌoina geya gwae namo, ma hesi waiwaiyega.
Togidega ꞌimi nuwatuhu? Maꞌigu loina paꞌalina yanaowa, bo maꞌigu helau ma maꞌigu nuwabiga yanaowa? Waboi wahesinuwa.
